player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleeya {player_id} ({role}) long gem {num_rounds}-raun bilong Matching Pennies.
- Long bek raun, yu sandaem [heads] o [tails] (o [h], [t]).
- Sapos yu pikim i makim olsem pikinini bilong yu, Pleeya 0 winim raun; narapela, Pleeya 1 winim.
Yu reply wantaim pikinini bilong yu long fomat '[heads]' o '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomat i no gut; pleez sandaem '[heads]' o '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Pleeya 0 pikim {choice0}; Pleeya 1 pikim {choice1}. Match -> Pleeya 0 winim
message.round_mismatch: Pleeya 0 pikim {choice0}; Pleeya 1 pikim {choice1}. Mismatch -> Pleeya 1 winim.

outcome.p1_wins: Man 1 i winim planti moa raun.
